resources.string: Ye app Al Arab Electronic ki qist wale phone par chalti hai. Pehle shop par QR se set hogi, phir ye khud lock / unlock kare gi.
Aam tor par isay badalne ki zaroorat nahi — ye pehle se theek bhara hua hai.
Pairing Code (8 harf — dashboard se mila code)
Register ho raha hai… (server jag raha ho to 1 minute lag sakta hai)
Check ho gaya — halat theek hai
Check ho gaya — phone ab theek hai
Register nahi hai — pairing code likhein
Warning — qist late hai, grace period chal raha hai
Mubarak — tamam qistein ada, phone aap ka hai
Active hai — phone lock ho sakta hai
Active NAHI hai — ye normal app hai, lock nahi kare gi. QR se set karein.
Phone mehfooz NAHI hai — Device Owner band hai. Jab tak dobara set na ho, ye phone lock nahi ho sakta aur register bhi nahi ho ga.
Pehle device owner banayein — phone abhi device owner nahi hai, is liye register nahi ho sakta aur lock nahi kare ga. Phone ko QR se set karein ya adb command se device owner banayein.
✓ Register ho gaya — phone mehfooz hai
Purani registration khatam ho jaye gi aur aap ko pairing code dobara likhna pare ga. Ye sirf tab karein jab shop ke kahe par code badal raha ho.
Reset ho gaya — pairing code dobara likhein
Registration reset karne ke liye shop ka Reset PIN likhein. Ye PIN dashboard mein shop ke paas hota hai — customer ke paas nahi.
Reset PIN ghalat hai — reset nahi hua. Sahi PIN shop se lein.
Pehle pairing code likhein (8 harf wala code jo dashboard se mila)
Code ghalat hai — dashboard se code dobara parh kar likhein
Internet nahi hai — Wi-Fi ya mobile data check karein, phir dobara karein
Server so raha hai — 1 minute baad dobara karein
Server URL ghalat hai — https:// se shuru hona chahiye
Server se jawab nahi aa raha — thori der baad dobara karein (%1$s)
Ye phone server par registered nahi hai — dobara register karein
nakaam — server dair se jawab de raha tha
nakaam — server par register nahi hai
nakaam — server ka jawab samajh nahi aaya (purani halat barkarar hai)
Warning — qist late hai, grace period chal raha hai. Tafseel dekhein.
Is app ko battery optimisation se bahar rakhein, warna check-in dair se hoga aur payment ke baad phone dair se khule ga.
Setting nahi khuli — Setting > Apps > AMG Lock > Battery mein ja kar "Unrestricted" karein
Aap ki qist waqt par ada nahi hui.
Qist ada karein to phone khud khul jaye ga.
Madad ke liye shop se rabta karein
Check ho gaya — halat waisi hi hai
Internet nahi hai — thori der baad dobara karein
Server dair se jawab de raha hai — 1 minute baad dobara karein
Server se jawab nahi aa raha — dobara karein
Payment kar di hai to "Abhi Check Karein" dabayein — warna phone 15 minute mein khud check kare ga.
Call nahi ho saki — dobara koshish karein
Offline code likhein (shop se mila code)
Ye code shop se milta hai — shop ko call karein ya shop par jayein. Code sirf aik dafa chalta hai.
Koi offline code jari nahi hua — shop se code lein
Ye code pehle istemal ho chuka hai
Code purana tha — phone dobara lock ho gaya. Shop se naya code lein.
Aap ki qist late hai. Grace period khatam hone par phone lock ho jaye ga. Abhi ada karein.
Is tareekh ko phone lock ho jaye ga
Qist ada karein — shop par ja kar ya shop ko call kar ke. Qist ada karte hi phone khud theek ho jaye ga.
Tamam qistein ada ho gayi hain. Ye app khud uninstall ho jaye gi aur phone hamesha ke liye khul jaye ga.
Agar app uninstall na ho to shop se rabta karein — phone ab bilkul aap ka hai, is par koi lock nahi hai.
Device Owner abhi hatna baqi hai — "Dobara Koshish Karein" dabayein. Agar phir bhi na hate to shop se rabta karein.
Uninstall ka prompt khul gaya — "Uninstall" dabayein. Agar prompt band ho jaye to dobara is button ko dabayein.
Uninstall khud nahi khula — Setting > Apps > AMG Lock > Uninstall karein, ya shop se madad lein.
